title: Manhattan Nocturne Chess
summary: New York after midnight, translated into a complete architectural chess set with ordinary chess rules.
description:
A one-piece beveled checkerboard and two distinct Manhattan skylines turn standard chess into an adult New York place portrait. Water towers, parapets, bridge cantilevers, avenue-cut bishops, Art Deco queens, and neo-Gothic kings make every role recognizable without literal souvenir landmarks.

By Alice.

wish.objective: Have Alice create a really cool chess set with NYC building style.

components: one seamless 244 x 244 mm beveled street-grid chess board
instructions: Set up and play with the standard rules of chess. Use the raised square at each player's right, keep each queen on her own square family, and lift pieces rather than dragging them across the relief.
